topic: States of Matter and Temperature Changes
key_concepts: Matter can be solid, liquid, or gas
Solids have definite shape and weight
Liquids take the shape of their container and can flow
Gas molecules are free and bouncing
Texture, color, shape, and weight describe matter
Temperature changes can change matter's form
Melting is a solid changing to liquid
Freezing is a liquid changing to solid
Evaporation is liquid to gas and condensation is gas to liquid
Sublimation is solid to gas and deposition is gas to solid
Objects can be grouped by shape, texture, or weight
Everyday examples include ice melting, water freezing, and butter softening
